rows.name: direct_zero_multi_pipeline
rows.source:
#42
fn zero() => 42
fn combine(a,b,c) => a*100+b*10+c
assert(zero()==42)
assert(combine(1,2,3)==123)
assert((3 |> combine(1,2))==123)
var seen = ""
fn mark(x) { seen = seen + str(x)
 x }
assert(combine(mark(4),mark(5),mark(6))==456)
assert(seen=="456")

rows.name: escaping_parameter_cells
rows.source:
#42
fn make(n) { n+=10
 () => { n+=2
 n } }
let a=map(make,[1,2,3])
assert(a[2]()==15)
assert(a[0]()==13)
assert(a[2]()==17)
assert(a[1]()==14)
let b=make(1)
assert(b()==13)
assert(a[0]()==15)

rows.name: parameter_rebind_vs_alias
rows.source:
#42
let x=[1]
let o={n:2}
fn edit(a,b) { a[0]+=4
 b.n+=5
 a=[99]
 b={n:99}
 [a,b] }
let r=edit(x,o)
assert(x==[5])
assert(o.n==7)
assert(r[0]==[99])
assert(r[1].n==99)
let rows=[x,o]
let seen=map((v)=>{v},rows)
seen[0][0]=8
seen[1].n=9
assert(x[0]==8)
assert(o.n==9)

rows.name: join_unicode_nul_alias
rows.source:
#42
let nul=chr(0)
let a=["", "中", "🙂", nul, ""]
let alias=a
let result=join("|",a)
assert(result=="|中|🙂|"+nul+"|")
assert(join("",a)=="中🙂"+nul)
assert(join("x",[])=="")
assert(join("x",[""])=="")
alias[1]="changed"
assert(result=="|中|🙂|"+nul+"|")
assert(a[1]=="changed")
